Fixed before training. Three RoBERTa seeds are trained on
R_clean, so without this the H2 baseline would be chosen after
training - even selecting on validation is a best-of-three
choice, and comparing a best-of-three single model against a
single jury configuration is asymmetric in either direction.
Seeds 2 and 3 estimate initialization variability, supply the
RoBERTa seed jury (A'), and provide replication context; they
are never candidates for the H2 baseline.
Frozen before the first model-training run. Every value here is fixed for
all 45 Part-A runs. run_experiments.py reads this file, records its
SHA-256 in every output, and refuses command-line overrides of any frozen
field. Changing anything after the first run invalidates Phase 1.
_class_weighting_rationale: Unweighted cross-entropy for every Phase-1 run. For H3 the jurors and
their saved probability vectors are identical across the weighted- and
equal-weight aggregation conditions; only the aggregation rule differs.
For H2 the same unweighted objective applies to the single-model baseline
and to every jury member, so class weighting is not introduced as an
additional experimental factor beyond the pre-specified single-model-
versus-jury design. The retained corpus is highly imbalanced (disgust
1.36%, fear 1.74%, joy 57.7%), so a rare class may receive low or zero
F1; that is reported as an empirical result and does not modify the
Phase-1 protocol. If exactly one class scores F1 = 0 and the other five
are perfect, macro-F1 is capped at 5/6 = 0.833. Balanced weighting, if
evaluated, is a separately labelled Phase-2 sensitivity analysis and does
not replace the frozen Phase-1 results.

_max_length_rationale: Measured on the frozen corpus with both pinned tokenizers before any
training. Pre-specified rule: smallest limit in [64, 128, 256] for which
at most 5% of examples exceed it under BOTH tokenizers.

_note: The checkpoint evaluated on test is the epoch with the highest
validation macro-F1, restored before test inference. Training stops
early after 2 consecutive epochs without improvement. Selection uses
validation only; the test set is touched once, after selection.

_model_seeds_note: Three seeds for BERT/R_clean, RoBERTa/R_clean and RoBERTa/R_overlap.
Jury members (complementary partitions, disjoint thirds) use seed 1 only;
their diversity comes from the training partition, not initialization.

_note: Full CUDA determinism is not enforced: it slows training substantially
and does not hold across GPU models anyway. Exact bitwise reproduction
of a run is therefore not claimed. What is reproducible is the pipeline
and the analysis, from the released per-sample predictions.
